outcome: leptin levels in umbilical cord blood
IL-6 levels in umbilical cord blood
TNF-a levels in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 125 samples of umbilical cord blood from healthy term newborns.
finding: Leptin and IL-6 concentrations were higher in umbilical cord blood following vaginal delivery compared to caesarean section.
mod_finding: Leptin and IL-6 had higher concentrations in umbilical cord blood in vaginal delivery than in caesarean section.
cross-section timing: At birth, from umbilical cord blood.
